biography: Arkira Chantaratananond (born June 19, 2001) is an American actress based in Los Angeles.
name: Arkira Chantaratananond

cast.title: Bury Your Fish
cast.overview: A young woman, desperate to rediscover purpose in life, takes guidance from a flashing light a block away.

cast.title: Twinless
cast.overview: Two men who lost their respective twin brothers develop a growing friendship after meeting in a support group. However, both harbor long-hidden secrets that threaten to tear them apart.

cast.title: Chinese School
cast.overview: A Chinese-American teenager attends Chinese classes on weekends with his friend Monica. He falls in love with Abigail, a very religious girl, which leads him to question his identity and values.

cast.title: The Plan
cast.overview: Inside a modest Los Angeles apartment over the course of a single day, a group of disillusioned young adults prepares for a radical act they believe will change the world. As paranoia builds and fractures deepen, the lines between purpose, fear, and identity blur.

cast.title: Night Always Comes
cast.overview: Facing eviction in a city her family can no longer afford, a woman plunges into a desperate and increasingly dangerous all-night search to raise $25,000.

cast.title: The Last Kiss
cast.overview: Laurel always imagined her first kiss would be a fairy tale. Instead, that fantasy turns frightening when she's cursed with an ability to see the death of anyone she kisses. After a vision reveals her crush is doomed to die in a strange murder spree targeting her closest friends, she races to unmask the killer before the mystery becomes a massacre.

cast.title: Paradise Records
cast.overview: Cooper is trying to keep the doors of Paradise Records open with its motley crew of entertaining employees, even as the world works against him.

cast.title: Downbeat
cast.overview: After fleeing his mistakes in Atlanta to crash with his sister in Boston, a self-destructive street bucket drummer repeatedly undermines his own fresh start, dragging everyone around him into the fallout of his feral behavior.
A team of nurses help to guide patients and loved ones with finding peace and wrapping up loose ends with compassion and dignity.
